title: Software Engineering Intern
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program in Computer Science or a related technical field.
qualification: Pursuing BS/MS/PhD in CS or STEM discipline
description: Work on core product areas, build scalable software applications, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and solve complex technical challenges.

title: Chevening Master's Scholarship
eligibility: Citizens of Chevening-eligible countries with at least 2 years of work experience and an undergraduate degree.
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, living stipend, flight allowance)
description: Fully-funded scholarship allowing outstanding future leaders to pursue any one-year master's degree at any UK university.

title: Junior Frontend Engineer
eligibility: Open to worldwide applicants with experience in JavaScript, Vue.js, HTML/CSS, and Git.
qualification: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
description: Develop and enhance UI components across GitLab's open-core platform while working asynchronously in an all-remote environment.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone globally interested in learning computer science concepts.
description: An entry-level course teaching algorithmic thinking, problem-solving, and foundational programming in C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Imagine Cup Global Student Competition
eligibility: Students aged 18+ enrolled in an accredited higher education institution.
salary: Up to $100,000 USD grand prize + Azure credits + Mentorship
description: Annual global technology competition challenging students to build innovative AI-driven software solutions utilizing Microsoft Cloud services.

title: Associate Product Manager
eligibility: Recent graduates or professionals with 0-2 years of product management or relevant technical experience.
qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in CS, Engineering, or related fields
description: Lead product initiatives across Meta's applications, analyze user engagement data, and work directly with engineering and design teams.
